   **Suggestion:** Catch storage access separately, then resolve and apply the theme even when storage is unavailable. Ensure React uses the same resolution rules for absent, invalid, and inaccessible stored values. Cover these cases in the no-flash tests.

   **Suggestion:** Explicitly use raw persisted values for setup status and initial form values, retaining fallback application in the existing PDF path. Test absent settings, whitespace-only values, and the stored example sender.
